description: This file declares cryptographic random number generation functions within the WPEFramework::Crypto namespace, including functions for generating random values of various integer types and a template for generating random values within a specified range.

methods.name: Random(int8_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int8_t value by casting to uint8_t.

methods.name: Random(int16_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int16_t value by casting to uint16_t.

methods.name: Random(int32_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int32_t value by casting to uint32_t.

methods.name: Random(int64_t&)
methods.description: Inline function that generates a random int64_t value by casting to uint64_t.

methods.name: Random(DESTTYPE& value, const DESTTYPE minimum, const DESTTYPE maximum)
methods.description: Template function that generates a random value of any type within a specified range.
